title: Welcome to the new Dualmines website
author: Dualmines Team
body: Dualmines has a brand new home on the web! You can now find the server IP, our rules, the staff team and the latest news all in one place.
Keep an eye on this page for updates, events and giveaways. Join our Discord at https://discord.gg/uB8V8hsAcp to hear about them first.

title: Server rules are now online
author: Dualmines Team
body: Our full Server Guidelines, covering both the Discord and the Minecraft server, are now on the Rules page.
Please give them a read before you jump in. **No hacking, exploiting, combat logging or scripting.** Staff decisions are final.
